# Church Presenter rebuilds caption styling


By OpenTools Team


·


November 7, 2026


Display settings do not supply speech.


##


Output profiles


Church Presenter’s[November 1 update](https://www.churchpresenter.org/blog/november-2026-updates/) styles captions through named output profiles. Two outputs sharing a profile change together; linked profiles inherit settings but can override others. Captions now offer roll-up, pop-on or ticker presentation, with reading-speed limits and silence fading. Interface zoom affects only the operator UI. Caption overlays remain opt-in.


If captions reach both rooms but the overflow font is wrong, change a linked profile’s override; changing their shared profile changes both. Interface zoom fixes neither audience view.


##


Follow the speech feed


The[July guide](https://www.churchpresenter.org/blog/how-to-set-up-live-captions-and-translation-in-church-presenter) describes STT as a client for a networked Whisper server, not microphone capture. Enable the hidden STT tab, connect its server URL, then use Go Live and select STT for the intended output in Settings → Projection. Translation runs server-side.


Diagnostic proposal, not a tested setup: if transcription arrives without translated text, check server-side translation before profile appearance. Incoming transcription proves neither translated input nor projection routing. If both languages reach STT but only one appears on a screen, inspect the STT display mode and that output’s assignment. Font changes cannot create missing translated input. Rehearse on a spare output.


Conceptual routing, not observed.
